airzone_add.zone_title: A thermostat or zone on an existing gateway
airzone_add.zone_help: The Local API does not support physical pairing or unpairing. Moli automatically discovers zones already added to Airzone.
airzone_add.zone_step1: Pair the device using your Airzone system manual or with your installer.
airzone_add.zone_step2: Check that the new zone responds in Airzone, then wait for Moli’s next poll.
airzone_add.zone_step3: Find the zone in Moli, then choose its name and room. A zone on an already configured gateway does not require a restart.
airzone_add.restore_help: Restore its card from the device list. Its readings and history are retained.
airzone_add.gateway_help: Check its connection, then add it to Moli. Its zones will appear automatically, without restarting.
airzone_add.host_help: Find this address in Airzone or your router’s device list. Enter a local IPv4 address here, without “http://”.
airzone_add.id_help: This ID distinguishes the gateway in Moli. Keep the suggested value unless you want to choose another.
airzone_add.fingerprint_help: Use an independently verified fingerprint for this gateway. Moli does not automatically trust an unknown certificate.
airzone_add.awaiting_pin: Confirm access in the Moli code window to continue this step.
airzone_add.incomplete: Some zone data is incomplete. Moli will show only the zones it can recognise.
airzone_add.empty_gateway: The gateway responds but does not yet report any zones. Zones later added to Airzone will be discovered automatically.
airzone_add.install_help: Moli checks the gateway identity again before saving. Other connections are preserved.
airzone_add.saved_help: The “{instance}” connection is saved as read-only. Discovery is starting; zones appear as the first readings arrive.
airzone_add.uncertain: The response did not confirm saving. You can resume this step with the same settings: Moli will check whether the gateway is already saved, without creating a second copy.
airzone_add.error.invalid_instance: Use a 1–32 character ID: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter. Internal Moli names are reserved.
airzone_add.error.invalid_host: Enter a valid local IPv4 address without a protocol or path. DNS names and public addresses are not accepted in this form.
airzone_add.error.invalid_port: The port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
airzone_add.error.invalid_fingerprint: Enter the full certificate SHA-256 fingerprint: 64 hexadecimal characters, with or without separators.
airzone_add.error.expected_identity_requ: Check the gateway before adding it.
airzone_add.error.invalid_identity: The received identity is invalid. Check the gateway again.
airzone_add.error.duplicate_instance: This ID is already used. Choose another in the connection settings.
airzone_add.error.duplicate_gateway: This gateway is already configured in Moli. It has not been added a second time.
airzone_add.error.identity_unavailable: The identity of an existing gateway is unavailable. Check its connection and settings in the installation, then try again.
airzone_add.error.identity_changed: The gateway identity has changed. No connection was changed. Check again or use hardware replacement.
airzone_add.error.probe_failed: A compatible Airzone gateway could not be verified at this address. Check its power, address, port and whether its Local API is enabled.
airzone_add.error.busy: A check is already running or requests are too close together. Try again shortly.
airzone_add.error.limit_reached: The maximum number of gateways added from Moli has been reached.
airzone_add.error.persistence_failed: Moli could not save the gateway. No new connection was started.
airzone_add.error.unavailable: Gateway management is unavailable on this Moli instance.
airzone_add.error.shutting_down: Moli is shutting down. Wait for it to return before trying again.
airzone_add.error.network: The connection to Moli was interrupted. Your settings remain in this form.
airzone_add.error.response: Moli returned an unexpected response. This step is not confirmed.
airzone_add.error.server: Moli did not confirm this step. Check its status before trying again.
airzone_add.error.auth: Your access was not confirmed. Validate your Moli code, then try again.
airzone_add.error.auth_busy: Another action is already awaiting your approval. Complete or cancel it before continuing.
airzone_add.error.cancelled: Approval cancelled. Your settings are retained.
airzone_add.error.connection: Moli is disconnected. Wait for it to reconnect before managing gateways.
airzone_add.error.verify_first: Check the gateway with these settings first.
airzone_add.error.not_found: This gateway is no longer saved. Refresh the list.
airzone_add.error.instance_mismatch: The identifier does not match the selected connection. Reopen its form.
airzone_add.error.gateway_disabled: This connection is paused. Check it before resuming.
airzone_add.error.unaddressable_instance: Legacy identifiers “.” and “..” remain visible, but managing them from this page requires a configuration migration.
airzone_add.error.mode_conflict: The mode changed in another window. The list was refreshed; choose your action again.
airzone_add.error.invalid_mode: The requested mode is invalid. Refresh the list before trying again.
airzone_add.error.owner_required: Only an owner can authorize control.
airzone_add.error.pin_required: Enter your Moli code again to authorize control.
airzone_add.error.pin_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
airzone_add.error.pin_disabled: Set up a Moli code before authorizing control.
airzone_add.error.configuration_locked: The configuration file prevents this authorization.
airzone_add.error.revocation_not_persist: The revocation has not been saved. Retry saving it before changing this gateway.
